subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Johnson, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Date: August 15, 2023 Departure Time: 10:00 AM Origin: New York (JFK) Destination: Paris (CDG) We recommend arriving at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Please ensure you have all necessary travel documents. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
